hypothesis: With m2 fixed at 0.5 on data_seed 1, seed 23's small 12000-step N=64 minus N=128 force gap (0.8467 - 0.8150 = 0.032, both at layer 1, both read from probes_final) comes from slow convergence, not a lower ceiling. N=64 seed 23 had levelled off (0.8465 at step 6000, 0.8467 at step 12000), while N=128 gained 0.015 over steps 6000-12000. Here N=128 seed 23 (4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls) is trained to 24000 steps. Its final layer-1 trained force R2 comes within 0.02 of 0.8467. Values are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and the layer is reported. A best layer other than 1 is flagged as cross-layer. Within-run values are read as that layer's control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. Horizon check: step-12000 trained force R2 must be within 0.03 of the 12000-step N=128 seed-23 run (0.8150, layer 1); otherwise the result is reported as horizon-confounded.
expected_if_true: Final trained force R2 >= 0.827 (gap to N=64 <= 0.02) and step-12000 to step-24000 gain >= 0.01. accel_step headroom-normalised margin in [0.60, 0.85].
expected_if_false: Final trained force R2 <= 0.807 (gap >= 0.04), or a step-12000 to step-24000 gain <= 0.005 with the final gap still >= 0.03 (a plateau below N=64). Any outcome between these bands is inconclusive.
